purpose: Compact durable identity for the expensive lessons of the HCLI operator campaign (S033-S036). Carry the Law, not the story that created it -- but keep the evidence ref so the Law can be re-checked, never blindly trusted.

laws.law: An advertised capability with no reachable implementation is a bug, not a feature. A flag parsed and never read, a tool registered with no call site, a menu shape that disagrees with the schema, a template slot left empty -- each makes correct action look like model failure.

Before blaming a body, confirm it was shown a fair contract: system message present, tools declared in the artifact's own slot, dialect it was trained on, schema its dialect can express. sealed-3.14 reached for `shell` because its tools slot was empty; it emitted "200" because XML cannot express an integer. Every apparent incapacity this campaign investigated was the lab.

Python invalidates a .pyc on (mtime, size). A same-length source change inside one mtime second leaves both intact, so a validation re-run imports the OLD bytecode. Red-before-green rolled back a CORRECT mutation this way. Validation subprocesses must set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE.
A preflight or tool that resolves relative paths against the process cwd checks the wrong tree from any surface not sitting in the repo -- and silently passes. Anchor to the engine root explicitly.

A bare `except` that returns a fallback hides a real break when the fallback happens to equal the right answer. context_budget.resolve is keyword-only; a positional call raised and returned a fallback that matched. Make fallbacks deliberately implausible so the next failure surfaces.
A server that reaps its child in a `finally` leaks it on SIGTERM, because the default handler skips finally. 11 orphaned model servers held ~7 GB of swap. Handle SIGTERM/SIGHUP/SIGINT explicitly.

A load-bearing function with no caller in the suite is untested by definition. system_block referenced two undefined names and 60 tests passed because none called it. A green suite around an uncalled function proves nothing about it.

When two mechanisms could each satisfy an assertion, a test that cannot tell them apart proves neither. The authority mutation-check passed on the engine gate while claiming to prove the menu gate. Separate the gates, assert the specific reason.

A valid envelope, a zero exit, a resolved schema -- none means the objective was met. Keep PROPOSED, APPLIED, VALIDATED, ACCEPTED distinct; a rejected mutation is 'rejected', an untested edit is 'unproven', never 'fixed'.

No frontier movement means change method, not halt-and-wait-for-human. The stall detector and the frontier scheduler existed and never spoke; a stall demanded a person while another frontier sat READY. Consult the scheduler on stall.
